description: Teleriscaldamento - serie storica - Volumetria servita is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Milano. Il dataset espone, a partire dal 2011, la volumetria servita dal teleriscaldamento nel Comune di Milano (valori assoluti in m³). La volumetria servita è quella totale comprendente le utenze residenziali e non residenziali. Il dataset è stato estrapolato dalla tavola 8.5 energia Istat. Coverage: Comune di Milano. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Milano. Its tags are anno, seriestorica, teleriscaldamento. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
